title: Play from the cloud
items: Players with cloud play can press Play from the cloud on the launch page: a machine with a fast graphics card opens the year they chose and streams it to their browser, so a slow computer or a phone plays at full detail.
The page says plainly how it is going while the machine starts, usually in about a minute, and why when it cannot start one.
A cloud session ends by itself after ten minutes with nobody connected, and after two hours in any case.
